user.title: Security Dashboard
user.description: Adds a Security panel to the sidebar (admins only) that shows access logs, token hygiene and outbound connections.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Security Dashboard is already set up.

ip_ban_disabled.title: IP banning is disabled
ip_ban_disabled.description: Repeated failed logins are never blocked. Add `ip_ban_enabled: true` and `login_attempts_threshold` to the `http:` section of configuration.yaml.

external_http.title: Remote access without HTTPS
external_http.description: Your external URL uses plain HTTP, so passwords and tokens travel unencrypted. Use Home Assistant Cloud, a reverse proxy with TLS, or configure `ssl_certificate`.

stale_tokens.title: Unused long-lived access tokens
stale_tokens.description: Some long-lived access tokens haven't been used in 90 days. Revoke the ones you no longer need under your profile → Security.
